title: Spiced Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and aromatic Indian-inspired tagine made with lamb mince, perfect for a cold evening. This flavorful dish is slow-cooked to perfection, resulting in tender meat and a rich sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee or vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced lamb and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the cumin, coriander, and salt, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mixture to a slow cooker or Dutch oven.
Add 250ml of water and stir to combine.
Cover and cook on low for 2 hours or until the meat is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
